UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile containing first name, last name, phone number, email, and metadata

id.description: Unique user ID matching Firebase Auth UID

avatar.description: User avatar URL or initial letter

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when user first signed up

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when user profile was last updated

lastLoginAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms of last login

OtpRecord.title: OtpRecord
OtpRecord.description: Tracks passwordless OTP verification sessions with expiry and attempt limits

identifier.description: Phone number or email address receiving OTP

otpHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the generated 6-digit OTP code

expiresAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when OTP expires (5 minutes from creation)

verified.description: Whether OTP has already been verified and consumed

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when OTP session was initiated

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document containing account and contact details

/otp_verifications/{otpId}.description: Temporary OTP verification sessions for email and mobile login
